messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 10):
"""
IRDAI –-HIP [All the items should be filled in properly and carefully. No item must be left blank.] S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) Section I: General Information 1.1 Name of Life / Health / General Insurer 1.2 Registration No. allotted by IRDAI 1.3 Name of Appointed Actuary [Please note that his/her appointment should be in force as on the date of this application] 1.4 Type of product Base Product/Add-on/Rider 1.5 Brand Name [Give the name of the product which will be printed in Sales Literature and known in the market. This name should not be altered / modified in any form after launching in the market. This name shall appear in all returns etc. which would be submitted to IRDAI.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
